title: Vegan Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy vegan stir fry made with juicy onions and served as a snack.

ingredients.name: saudia
ingredients.notes: such as sesame or olive oil

ingredients.name: fry
ingredients.notes: any variety of vegan stir-fry mix

instructions: Heat the saudia in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the fry and cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 4-5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
